summary: Iteration 13 testing complete. Verified backend endpoints (12/12 pytest passed) and mobile UI end-to-end. Admin Familles tab lists 25 families with all expected fields + Supprimer button. DELETE /api/family/{id} removes user AND cascades sessions delete. Session double-tap protection verified at API layer (2nd complete returns already_completed=true, mopado_earned=0, no double reward). Family Wall loads properly for logged-in user (no infinite spinner) showing 45 Mopado$, 3 badges, 3 episodes, 14 sessions, badges list, mots de fin. Profile screen 'Supprimer mon compte' button opens confirmation modal with irreversible warning; Annuler closes it; Supprimer confirms → user deleted server-side (GET 400 after) + not in families list + redirected to /login. Fixed one minor text mismatch: already-completed banner in session screen now says 'Aucun Mopado$ ni badge à gagner' (was 'Aucun Mopado$ à gagner') to match the request spec.
action_items: No blocking issues. Optionally consider soft-delete for accounts to preserve history for audits (currently hard-delete of user + sessions is per spec).

Consider adding an admin-only guard (currently /api/admin/families and /api/family/{id} DELETE are unauthenticated — any client can hit them). Not blocking for internal admin panel but worth adding auth eventually.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py delete_family_account: sessions are cleaned via delete_many({'family_id': user_id}) — good, and matches request.
list_families returns created_at.isoformat() (safe) and no MongoDB _id — verified by test.
family-wall.tsx correctly uses useFocusEffect with user?.id dependency and always sets isLoading=false, preventing infinite spinner.
session/[episodeId].tsx uses useRef guard isCompletingRef — correct pattern for immediate double-tap prevention.

session/[episodeId].tsx: banner text at line 286 originally said 'Aucun Mopado$ à gagner' — updated by testing agent to include 'ni badge' per request. Full alt-screen text at line 902 was already correct.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up several TEST_delete_* accounts during pytest. Created TEST_ui_delete_e2e@mopado.fr during UI test and it was deleted via the mobile flow (verified via GET 400 + families list).
